name: odoo-to-sheet
description: Connect to Odoo, configure reusable sales report filters and columns, and export CSV.

interface.shortDescription: Configure and export Odoo sales reports.
interface.longDescription: Connect to Odoo, save local connection profiles, reuse or change sale.report domains and columns, and export CSV. Odoo business records are read-only.
defaultPrompt: Use /odoo2sheet-connect to connect, then /odoo2sheet-salereport to export sale.report data
